contract_clause: Parent configuration space must split as Q_parent = Q_dyn x K_global with kappa_* in K_global.
why_it_matters: This makes local variations delta kappa_*=0 by construction.

contract_clause: The local action must not contain an independently propagating kappa(x) field in the Newton/PPN sector.
why_it_matters: Otherwise d_t ln kappa_eff is a live scalar residual.

contract_clause: The action must state whether kappa_eff is fundamental, or the quotient kappa_* C_G/C_M is the emergent coupling.
why_it_matters: Without this, Gdot zero is only a calibration assumption.

contract_clause: The source/gravity charges C_M and C_G must be conserved in the local tube.
why_it_matters: This imports the 3757 side-flux and projected-exchange clauses.

contract_clause: Poisson calibration and source/frame normalization factors must have no local drift or must be separately bounded.
why_it_matters: This prevents hiding Gdot in Z_Poisson or Z_frame.

contract_clause: Even if d_t G_eff=0 is derived, the absolute value of measured G is not derived until kappa_* or the charge quotient normalization is predicted.
